title: Filtered homotopies induce equal page maps from the second page
statement: Under the bounded filtered-complex and filtration-shift hypotheses of lem-sp-filtered-homotopy-spectral-sequence, every FilteredPageTwoModel sends the two homotopic filtered maps to equal spectral-sequence morphisms.

source.place: Lemma 012O (homology-lemma-spectral-sequence-filtered-complex-functorial) together with Definition 012U (homology-definition-filtered-complex-ss-converges), applied to the filtered-complex homotopy calculation

proof.text: Use the bounded filtered-complex spectral-sequence construction and its Z_r/B_r representative description. For r ≥ 2, the degree −1 filtration shift puts the homotopy term in the r-boundary filtration, so the difference of the induced maps is zero on every page. Naturality of the page-two model identifies these equalities with equality of the functorial spectral-sequence maps.

theorem filteredHomotopy_page_map_eq
    (K L : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration K) (G : DecreasingFiltration L)
    (hKF : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ pmin : ℤ, ∃ pmax : ℤ,
      F.complexStep pmin n = ⊤ ∧ F.complexStep pmax n = ⊥)
    (hLG : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ pmin : ℤ, ∃ pmax : ℤ,
      G.complexStep pmin n = ⊤ ∧ G.complexStep pmax n = ⊥)
    (a b : FilteredObject.HomPreservingSteps ⟨K, F⟩ ⟨L, G⟩)
    (H : Homotopy a.hom b.hom)
    (hshift : ∀ (p n : ℤ), ∃ ℓ :
      (F.complexStep p n : C) ⟶ (G.complexStep (p - 1) (n - 1) : C),
      ℓ ≫ (G.complexStep (p - 1) (n - 1)).arrow =
        (F.complexStep p n).arrow ≫ H.hom n (n - 1)) :
    ∀ (M : FilteredPageTwoModel C), M.S.map a = M.S.map b

reviewed_lean.note: C,D abelian Abelian C; filtrations DecreasingFiltration by subcomplexes; degreewise finiteness hKF/hLG via complexStep top/bottom; a,b FilteredObject.Hom; a-b=dh+hd via Mathlib Homotopy (a = dh+hd+b); h^n(F^p)<=F^(p-1) via hshift factorization through complexStep (p-1)(n-1); E_r r>=2 equality as M.S.map a = M.S.map b for every FilteredPageTwoModel; abutment as image filtration of H^n(F^p) (same form as landed citer CartanEilenbergComparisonIndependence), common filtered map t = H(a) = H(b) and common graded map pinned by cokernel projection; added stmt_deps page-two-model and filtered-complex-subquotients are used (FilteredPageTwoModel, complexStep)
